title: a16z Podcast: The Law (and Tech) of Warfare

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Rules, guidelines, regulations.
reader_summary.overview: Rules, guidelines, regulations, and “laws” are all sometimes used interchangeably — but what’s legal and what isn’t is far more complex when it comes to policy. Take encryption for instance. And what of cybersecurity more broadly, Russia and hacking, and other top-of-mind policy and politics topics, such as immigration?

key_points.text: What are the legal and technical (not to mention moral) nuances of military drones … including the possibility of automating even government decision making in the future?.
